name: polymorfa/sdk
description: Handwritten Polymorfa server SDK for PHP

suggest.symfony/http-foundation: Use the Symfony raw-body webhook adapter.
suggest.illuminate/http: Use the Laravel raw-body webhook adapter.
suggest.phrity/websocket: Use native server Calls WebSocket transport.
suggest.mongodb/mongodb: Use the optional official MongoDB replica-set storage adapter.
suggest.aws/aws-sdk-php: Use the optional official DynamoDB storage and S3-compatible media adapters.
suggest.google/cloud-firestore: Use the optional official typed V1 RPC Firestore storage adapter; verified with package 1.55.0 and gRPC 1.84.
suggest.illuminate/database: Use Eloquent schema2 query-model exports and borrowed PDO storage.
suggest.turso/libsql: Optional technical-preview storage driver: PHP >=8.3 and FFI; install separately from the PHP 8.2 core.
